title: Build bounded parallel drain with schema and athena.toml landing togethe
summary: Retry of the parallel-jobs build: the drain runs items of one plan group concurrently up to a new `[parallel] max_concurrency` setting (default 1). The `parallel` field is added to the deny_unknown_fields Config in config.rs in the same change as the athena.toml section, so the file parses at every commit. Audience: the Athena user running a drain, who wants shorter wall time with serial behavior unchanged by default.

defaults_applied.how: Tests for config parsing and drain concurrency; cargo test, clippy, fmt pass.
Criteria check concurrency via barrier test, not wiring.
A test parses real athena.toml so schema/config drift fails the gate.
One focused slice; remaining parts deferred.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The new request is the same as the failed job's; the only change is ordering: schema field and athena.toml section land in one change.
Config uses deny_unknown_fields (read in config.rs), so the field must exist before the section is parsed.
Submit-time config-parse refusal from the introspection is a separate change and out of scope here.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test loads the repository's real athena.toml (with its [parallel] section) through Config and passes; a config without [parallel] parses and yields max_concurrency 1; a config with an unknown top-level section is rejected. Run `cargo test`.
A drain test with bound 1 shows items run strictly in the existing order, and all existing drain tests pass unchanged. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.

A drain test with bound 2 and two independent items in one group has both in flight at once (barrier; fails if serial), and an item depending on another starts only after it finishes. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
Tests show one item's failure or refusal does not stop its siblings, the worker bound is never exceeded, and Stop starts no further item. Run `cargo test`.
Ordering and retry rules are unchanged; `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` all pass.

athena.toml gains [parallel] only together with its schema field in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs in the same change; the field, default (1) and ceiling are documented where defined, and the athena.toml change is named and justified in the final report.
Drain and Report docs no longer say the loop runs one job at a time; docs/design/parallel-jobs.md and CHANGELOG.md state what this slice built and what remains (multi-job `athena go`, --pr phase).

departures: Larger than reference: concurrency in drain loop plus config, tests and docs, and the prior attempt failed.
